decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 02 revision A, 05 revision B, 06 revision B and Design and Access Statement received 19th November 2010 and information received 5th January 2011 and 12th January 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 8 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The rear access shall not be used for staff or customer access or egress except in cases of emergency.

Condition : 7 - On the rear boundary, where the existing extension is to be removed, a two metre high brick wall, in materials to match the rear of the main building, shall be constructed in its place for the full width of the space created adjacent to the existing rear gate which shall be retained and kept locked shut when not in use.

Condition : 8 - No refuse generated on site shall be stored other than in closed receptacles within the refuse storage area indicated on drawing No. 05 revision B and e-mail received 12th January 2010.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to dental surgery.
